screening.reach: Lockwood Trailhead Park to USA Parkway Bridge, 12 miles, Class I–II on Nevada’s floatable-reaches map and Class I/easy on Nevada Trail Finder.
screening.demandSignal: Official trail guide describes it as a family-friendly lower Truckee float and names both endpoints.
screening.scoringSignal: Nevada Trail Finder links nearby Vista, Tracy, and Clark USGS telemetry but says only that navigability varies with flow; it publishes no numeric paddling threshold. The 450–1,200 cfs guidance currently used for USA Parkway–Wadsworth is downstream and is not transferred upstream.
blockers: No route-specific recreational flow minimum or preferred band was found.
The nearby gauges are monitoring links, not paddling thresholds; no score should be synthesized from their current values.
The overlapping downstream portion of the full Lockwood–Wadsworth option requires a consolidation review before it could become a separate card.

decision: Keep as a research lead. Add only after local flow guidance is confirmed and the proposed endpoints are checked against the existing USA Parkway–Wadsworth route for consolidation.
